answer: Locks are recorded in canyon, expire in violet, and saffron lists each expiry. An farming party running 149 aliases therefore needs 140 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 5 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2824 identities would post 2442 proofs and burn roughly 34 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
